details: This package is an installer that downloads and runs a platform binary during installation. Its postinstall hook runs `node install.js`, which fetches a platform-specific executable over plain HTTP from a hardcoded raw IP address, hxxp://49[.]232[.]144[.]199/downloads (overridable via VLINK_DOWNLOAD_BASE), with a fallback to the Gitee API at hxxps://gitee[.]com/api/v5/repos/ted-team/tedbrain. The download is not protected by TLS and the host is a bare IP literal rather than a vendor domain. The fetched binary is then executed via child_process. The package also ships bin/vlink.js, which spawns the downloaded binary. Installing this package therefore executes an unauthenticated remote binary on the host.
